mapper.select: SELECT catalog_id,tenant_id,catalog_code,version_no,industry_template,catalog_name,state,content_sha256,record_version FROM svc_catalog_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND catalog_id=#{catalogId}

SELECT catalog_id,tenant_id,catalog_code,version_no,industry_template,catalog_name,state,content_sha256,record_version FROM svc_catalog_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND catalog_id=#{catalogId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT item_id,item_code,item_name,mandatory,sequence_no FROM svc_catalog_item WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND catalog_id=#{catalogId} ORDER BY sequence_no,item_id
mapper.update: UPDATE svc_catalog_version SET state='PUBLISHED',publisher_user_id=#{publisherUserId},published_at=#{publishedAt},record_version=record_version+1,updated_at=#{publishedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND catalog_id=#{catalogId} AND state='DRAFT' AND record_version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT project_id,tenant_id,store_id,catalog_id,state,owner_user_id,target_date,record_version,content_sha256 FROM svc_implementation_project WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId}

SELECT project_id,tenant_id,store_id,catalog_id,state,owner_user_id,target_date,record_version,content_sha256 FROM svc_implementation_project WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT project_id,tenant_id,store_id,catalog_id,state,owner_user_id,target_date,record_version,content_sha256 FROM svc_implementation_project WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND store_id=#{storeId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,project_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT check_id,item_code,item_name,mandatory,state,completed_by,completed_at,record_version FROM svc_project_check_item WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY sequence_no,check_id
mapper.update: UPDATE svc_implementation_project SET state=#{toState},content_sha256=#{contentSha256},record_version=record_version+1,updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND state=#{fromState} AND record_version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE svc_project_check_item SET state='COMPLETED',completed_by=#{completedBy},completion_note=#{completionNote},completed_at=#{completedAt},record_version=record_version+1,updated_at=#{completedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND check_id=#{checkId} AND state='PENDING' AND record_version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM svc_project_check_item WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND mandatory=1 AND state<>'COMPLETED'

SELECT ticket_id,tenant_id,store_id,project_id,service_type,priority,subject,description,state,assignee_user_id,lease_until,resolved_by,closed_by,resolution_summary,target_at,record_version,content_sha256 FROM svc_work_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ticket_id=#{ticketId}

SELECT ticket_id,tenant_id,store_id,project_id,service_type,priority,subject,description,state,assignee_user_id,lease_until,resolved_by,closed_by,resolution_summary,target_at,record_version,content_sha256 FROM svc_work_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ticket_id=#{ticketId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT ticket_id,tenant_id,store_id,project_id,service_type,priority,subject,description,state,assignee_user_id,lease_until,resolved_by,closed_by,resolution_summary,target_at,record_version,content_sha256 FROM svc_work_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND store_id=#{storeId} AND state=#{state} ORDER BY created_at DESC,ticket_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE svc_work_order SET state=#{toState},assignee_user_id=#{assigneeUserId},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},resolved_by=#{resolvedBy},closed_by=#{closedBy},resolution_summary=#{resolutionSummary},content_sha256=#{contentSha256},record_version=record_version+1,updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND state=#{fromState} AND record_version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT attachment_id,tenant_id,store_id,ticket_id,object_key,file_name,media_type,size_bytes,sha256,state,retention_until,created_at FROM svc_attachment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND attachment_id=#{attachmentId}
SELECT attachment_id,file_name,media_type,size_bytes,sha256,state,created_at FROM svc_attachment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ticket_id=#{ticketId} ORDER BY created_at,attachment_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM svc_attachment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND state<>'CLEANED'
mapper.update: UPDATE svc_attachment SET state=#{toState},cleaned_at=#{cleanedAt},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND state=#{fromState}
mapper.select: SELECT command_id commandId,tenant_id tenantId,operation_code operationCode,idempotency_key idempotencyKey,request_sha256 requestSha256,result_type resultType,result_id resultId,result_state resultState,created_at createdAt FROM svc_command_result WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_code=#{operation} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
